title_en: Free Legal Aid: Section 12 LSAA Eligibility, DLSA Services & NALSA 15100
title_hi: निःशुल्क कानूनी सहायता: धारा 12 पात्रता, जिला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण (DLSA) और नालसा 15100

laws.plain_meaning: Every person is entitled to free legal services if they are: (a) member of SC or ST; (b) victim of trafficking in human beings or begar; (c) a woman or a child; (d) person with disability or mental illness; (e) victim of mass disaster, ethnic violence, caste atrocity, flood, earthquake; (f) an industrial workman; (g) in custody in a protective home/juvenile home/psychiatric hospital/jail; or (h) having annual income less than the amount prescribed by State Government (typically Rs. 3,00,000; Supreme Court Legal Services Committee limit is Rs. 5,00,000).
Persons satisfying Section 12 criteria are entitled to legal services provided the Authority is satisfied that such person has a prima facie case to prosecute or defend.

Statutory alternative dispute resolution mechanism. Lok Adalat awards are deemed decrees of a civil court, final and binding with no appeal, and court fees paid in court are fully refunded when settled in Lok Adalat.

laws.section: Article 39A (Equal Justice and Free Legal Aid)
laws.plain_meaning: The State shall secure that the operation of the legal system promotes justice on a basis of equal opportunity, and shall in particular provide free legal aid to ensure that opportunities for securing justice are not denied to any citizen by reason of economic or other disabilities.

steps.action_en: Check eligibility under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act. All women, children, SC/ST citizens, persons in custody, and persons with annual income under state threshold (e.g. Rs. 3,00,000 in CG) automatically qualify without fee.
steps.action_hi: धारा 12 के तहत अपनी पात्रता जांचें। सभी महिलाएं, बच्चे, एससी/एसटी वर्ग, हिरासत में बंद व्यक्ति और निर्धारित आय सीमा से कम वाले नागरिक स्वतः पात्र हैं।
steps.where: Self check / NALSA Portal / DLSA Helpdesk
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Available at any stage (pre-litigation, trial, appeal)

steps.action_en: Contact NALSA on national toll-free helpline 15100 or visit the Front Office of the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) in the District Court premises or Taluk Legal Services Committee (TLSC) at Tehsil court.
steps.action_hi: राष्ट्रीय हेल्पलाइन 15100 पर कॉल करें या अपने जिला न्यायालय परिसर में स्थित 'जिला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण' (DLSA) के फ्रंट ऑफिस में जाएं।
steps.where: District Court DLSA Front Office / Tehsil TLSC / 15100 Helpline

steps.action_en: Submit the legal aid application detailing the dispute. The Front Office Secretary (Civil Judge cadre) scrutinizes the application and immediately passes an order assigning an empaneled legal aid advocate or Legal Aid Defense Counsel (LADC).
steps.action_hi: मामले का विवरण देकर आवेदन जमा करें। सचिव द्वारा तत्काल पैनल के योग्य वकील की नियुक्ति की जाती है।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Usually assigned within 2 to 4 working days (same day for custody/remand matters)

steps.action_en: Meet your assigned advocate at the DLSA office. The assigned advocate handles drafting, filing, court appearances, process fees, and certified copy costs at zero expense to the citizen.
steps.action_hi: प्राधिकरण कार्यालय में नियुक्त वकील से मिलकर केस पर चर्चा करें। ड्राफ्टिंग, फाइलिंग, पेशी और सर्टिफाइड कॉपी का पूरा खर्च सरकार वहन करती है।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Throughout the pendency of the case

helplines.name: NALSA National Legal Helpline
helplines.description: 24x7 pan-India toll-free helpline for legal counseling, lawyer assignment, and case status

helplines.name: NALSA Online Portal
helplines.description: Online application tracking and complaint filing

helplines.name: Tele-Law Service (Department of Justice)
helplines.description: Connects rural citizens to panel lawyers via video conference at Common Service Centres

free_legal_aid.eligible: All persons covered under Section 12 LSAA (women, children, custody detainees, SC/ST, disabled persons, disaster victims, workers, and citizens earning below state income limit).
free_legal_aid.how_to_apply: Directly through DLSA front office in district court, calling 15100, or through the NALSA portal / Tele-Law at the nearest Gram Panchayat CSC.
free_legal_aid.authority: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) / State Legal Services Authority (SLSA) / DLSA

when_to_see_a_lawyer: Whenever you receive a police notice, court summons, or warrant and cannot afford a private advocate
To appeal against adverse trial court convictions before the High Court or Supreme Court (via SCLSC)
To resolve ongoing disputes amicably in pre-litigation Lok Adalat without spending on court fees
